MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  NOVEMBER 19, 2024

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 7:02 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council
  Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Dr. N., Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR
  MCCORMICK.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR MCCORMICK led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Pope, Johnson,  Holdsworth,  Bain,  and
  McCormick

  Commissioners Absent:  Ciarolla and Persichina

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  OCTOBER 15, 2024

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE
  to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  OCTOBER 15, 2024.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MCCORMICK so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
November 19, 2024
   **ADJOURNED TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING AT
  7:03 PM**

  A.  2024 TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TENNIS TOURNAMENT DEBRIEF

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the Tracy Austin Doubles Tennis
  Tournament Debrief report (as per the agenda material).

  Coordinator Morrow stated that there were no issues with the members of the
  Rolling Hills Estates Tennis Club at Ernie Howlett Park regarding the tournament
  matches being played there as Staff notified the members in advance regarding
  the tournament dates and schedule, in response to COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH.

  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH asked what a possible third location would be
  to play additional matches. Coordinator Morrow responded that an ideal third
  location would be the South Bay Tennis Center.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN commented that it was nice to be able to speak with the
  Jack Kramer Club board members at the VIP reception.

  **RECONVENED PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING AT 7:08 PM**

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  DECEMBER MEETING DATE

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the upcoming December Park and
  Activities Commission meeting date and asked the COMMISSIONERS to let Staff
  know whether they would be unable to attend the December meeting.

  B.  FOUNDERS PARK UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief update on the status of the Founders Park project
  reporting that due to the contractor of Phase 2 being unable to complete the full
  scope of work listed in the Public Works contract, the City terminated the contract
  and is completing the project through another contractor. On November 12, the
  City awarded the contract to complete Phase 2 to Kormex Construction. The
  project was scheduled to be completed in early December.

  C.  2025 PROPOSED SPECIAL EVENT SCHEDULE

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the draft of the proposed 2025 special
  event schedule (as per the attached agenda material).

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
November 19, 2024
   D.  HOLIDAY PARADE OF LIGHTS UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief update regarding this year’s annual Holiday
  Parade of Lights. He noted that the pre-parade reception will once again be held
  at El Polla Inka and that invitations had been mailed. He also gave a brief overview
  of the current organizations that had registered for the parade and provided a
  sponsorship update.

  E.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.
  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF SEPTEMBER 10, 2024

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF SEPTEMBER 24, 2024

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  C.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF OCTOBER 8, 2024

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  10.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  ASSESSMENT OF SPACE FOR POTENTIAL DOG PARK AND FUTURE PARKS

  NONE.

  11.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR MCCORMICK ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:14 PM TO THE NEXT

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
November 19, 2024
   PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON DECEMBER 17, 2024, AT
  7:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD AT CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CITY
  HALL.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  __________________________
  Matt Morrow  Ryan McCormick
  Community Services Coordinator  Chair, Park & Activities Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
November 19, 2024
